pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT C.GROUPPANEL_1, C.PYSTATUSWORK as "pyStatusMessage", C.SOBNAME as "UserBusinessPA", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2', '3', '4') THEN C.Adjusterpic_1 ELSE '' END ) AS "StatusAnalystRemarks", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 = '1' THEN c.SURVEYORNAME_1 WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 = '2' AND c.businessname = 'MARINE HULL' THEN C.SURVEYORNAMEMARINE_1 ELSE '' END ) AS "SuspiciousComment", C.PYID AS "CaseID", a.lgb_note AS "AlasanDokterRejectRCL", c.policyno AS "TKI", (Select D.BRANCHNAME from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) AS "Usulan", ( select kanwil from pooldata.branch where id = (select D.BRANCHCODE from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) ) as "ResponseMsg", a.clientname AS "AnalystDoctorRemaks", a.nama_mo AS "AnalystRemaksInvestigator", a.occupation AS "AnaylstRemarks", a.noaksep AS "City", a.col_desc AS "CauseOfLoss", a.coveragename AS "CityID", (Select D.REPORTERNAME from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) AS "ReportType", ( DECODE ( a.sts_exgratia, '0', 'NO', NULL, 'YES' ) ) AS "ClaimEstimate", TO_CHAR (a.dateofloss, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "StatusWork", TO_CHAR (a.dateofloss, 'mm') AS "ClaimNo", TO_CHAR (a.dateofloss, 'yyyy') AS "CloseClaimNote", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_proses, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "UserTeknisEmail", a.thnregis AS "CommentKomiteClosecase", TO_CHAR (a.begindate, 'yyyy') AS "RefNo", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_aksep, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "DollarCurrencyVal", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_aksep, 'mm') AS "CompliancePosAuditByr", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_aksep, 'yyyy') AS "ComplianceRemark", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_reject, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "UserTeknis", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_reject, 'mm') AS "Conveyance", TO_CHAR (a.tgl_reject, 'yyyy') AS "Country", TO_CHAR (a.begindate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "UserTeknisGroup", TO_CHAR (a.enddate, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "RemarkRecommendation", TO_DATE ( TO_CHAR (a.tgl_proses, 'dd/mm/yyyy'), 'dd/mm/yyyy' ) - TO_DATE ( TO_CHAR (a.tgl_aksep, 'dd/mm/yyyy'), 'dd/mm/yyyy' ) AS "UserName", a.TSI AS "ProvinceID", a.ttlaksep AS "CountryID", a.ttlos AS "Currency", ( DECODE ( NVL(a.reinsurer, (SELECT d.leader_member FROM pooldata.t_claim_pnc d WHERE d.claimid = c.pzinskey)), '1', 'LEADER', 'LEADER', 'LEADER', '2', 'MEMBER', 'MEMBER', 'MEMBER', 'F', 'FAC-IN', 'FAC IN', 'FAC-IN' ) ) AS "DaftarObjek", a.risk_loc AS "Location", a.risk_loc_klaim AS "pyID", a.PIC AS "DistrictID", ( CASE WHEN (a.ttlaksep < 100000000) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END ) AS "DokumenLengkap", a.own_retension AS "ExGratiaNote", a.coins AS "FlagReject", a.psrspl AS "InsuredRelationship", a.qs_ri AS "PolicyObjectLocationRWNote", a.er1 AS "IsBackCFS", a.er2 AS "IsCFS", a.surplus1 AS "isComplianceTransfer", a.surplus2 AS "IsTransferAnalisator", a.psrqs_ri AS "IsTransferPIC", a.psrqs_or AS "InsuredRelationshipOthers", a.ors AS "KomiteStatus", a.facultative AS "District", a.facobl AS "LokasiSurveyor", a.bppdan AS "LossCoverage", a.xl AS "NamaDokumen", a.pss AS "NamaSurveyor", a.prgbi AS "NIK", a.fespl AS "NoKTP", (Select D.REPORTERNAME from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) AS "Resources", a.pfra AS "ProdKe", ( CASE WHEN a.stsklaim = '3' THEN a.ttlos ELSE 0 END ) AS "Province", ( select sum( z.PROPOSE_VALUE * z.currencyvalue ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || A.NOKLAIM and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) ) as "Password", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2', '3', '4') THEN ( select sum ( CASE WHEN paymenttype != '4' THEN (z.grossvalue * z.currencyvalue) ELSE 0 END ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) GROUP BY a.noklaim ) ELSE 0 END ) as "ReportAddress", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2', '3', '4') THEN 0 ELSE ( select sum ( CASE WHEN paymenttype != '4' THEN (z.grossvalue * z.currencyvalue) ELSE 0 END ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) GROUP BY a.noklaim ) END ) as "RCV_ID", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2', '3', '4') THEN ( ( select sum( z.PROPOSE_VALUE * z.currencyvalue ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) )-( select sum ( CASE WHEN paymenttype != '4' THEN (z.grossvalue * z.currencyvalue) ELSE 0 END ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) GROUP BY a.noklaim ) ) ELSE 0 END ) as "Remark", ( CASE WHEN C.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2', '3', '4') THEN 0 ELSE ( ( select sum( z.PROPOSE_VALUE * z.currencyvalue ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) )-( select sum ( CASE WHEN paymenttype != '4' THEN (z.grossvalue * z.currencyvalue) ELSE 0 END ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = C.PZINSKEY and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) GROUP BY a.noklaim ) ) END ) as "StatusEkonomis", ( select sum ( CASE WHEN paymenttype = '4' THEN (grossvalue * currencyvalue) ELSE ( select POOLDATA.Get_InterpolasiPNC( sum(TOTAL_CLAIM) ) from pooldata.T_CLAIM_ADJUSTMENT where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) ) END ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) GROUP BY a.noklaim ) AS "ReporterName", ( ( select ASM_SHARE from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) fetch next 1 row only )*( PRSN_OR + PRSN_ORS + PRSN_PSRQS_OR + PRSN_FSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR )/ 100 ) as "ReportDescription", ( ( select ASM_SHARE from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) fetch next 1 row only )*( PRSN_OR + PRSN_ORS + PRSN_PSRQS_OR + PRSN_FSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR )/ 100 ) as "StatusClaim", ( ( select ASM_SHARE from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) fetch next 1 row only )*( PRSN_OR + PRSN_ORS + PRSN_PSRQS_OR + PRSN_FSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR )/ 100 ) as "TelpTertanggung", ( ( select ASM_SHARE from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) fetch next 1 row only )*( PRSN_OR + PRSN_ORS + PRSN_PSRQS_OR + PRSN_FSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR )/ 100 ) as "UserAdmin", ( ( select ASM_SHARE from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) fetch next 1 row only )*( PRSN_OR + PRSN_ORS + PRSN_PSRQS_OR + PRSN_FSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR + PRSN_PSPLNSOR )/ 100 ) as "OldAddress", ( select sum( z.NILAI_SALVAGE_A * z.currencyvalue ) from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment z where z.claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || A.NOKLAIM and statusakseptasi = '1' and ( statusakseptasilod = '1' or statusakseptasilod is null ) ) as "RWID", ( SELECT I.STS_PROGRESS1 FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G, POOLDATA.GCNM_MST_PROGRESS_KLAIM I WHERE G.STATUS_PROGRESS1 = I.ID_PROGRESS AND G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "AgingAmount", ( select POOLDATA.GET_POSISI_PROGRESS2( G.PNCCASEID, G.ID_UPDATE, G.JSONSTATUS_PROGRESS2 ) from POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G where A.NOKLAIM = G.PNCCASEID AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "AlasanTerlambat", ( select doctype from pooldata.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM o where o.pnccaseid = a.noklaim and id_update =( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) as "ReporterTelp", ( SELECT TO_CHAR(G.TGL_INPUT, 'DD/MM/YY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "ReceiverClaim", ( SELECT G.KETERANGAN FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "pyNote", ( SELECT TO_CHAR(G.NEXT_FOLLOWUP, 'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "StatusReceiver", ( SELECT SUM(TERLAMBAT) AS RESPONSENOTE FROM ( SELECT ( CASE WHEN ( TRUNC(NEXT_FOLLOWUP) ) < ( SELECT TRUNC(TGL_INPUT) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = X.PNCCASEID AND ID_UPDATE = X.ID_UPDATE + 1 ) OR ( TRUNC(NEXT_FOLLOWUP) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND ( SELECT COUNT(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = X.PNCCASEID )= X.ID_UPDATE ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS TERLAMBAT FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM X WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and X.STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "RESPONSENOTE", ( SELECT SUM(TIDAKTERLAMBAT) AS RESPONSENOTE FROM ( SELECT ( CASE WHEN ( TRUNC(NEXT_FOLLOWUP) ) >= ( SELECT TRUNC(TGL_INPUT) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = Z.PNCCASEID AND ID_UPDATE = Z.ID_UPDATE + 1 ) OR ( TRUNC(NEXT_FOLLOWUP) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND ( SELECT COUNT(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = Z.PNCCASEID )= Z.ID_UPDATE ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS TIDAKTERLAMBAT FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM Z WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and Z.STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2', '24', '60', '59') ) ) AS "STATUSKOMUNIKASI", ( select COINSNAME from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_PNC where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim ) as "OwnRisk", substr(K.OBJECTNAME, 0, 100) as "TypeOfAddress", ( SELECT TO_CHAR(G.TGL_INPUT, 'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS1 in ('017', '018') ) ) AS "view_email", ( SELECT TO_CHAR(G.NEXT_FOLLOWUP, 'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = ( SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE) FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = A.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS1 in ('017', '018') ) ) AS "view_ktp", A.NOPOLIS || '/' || A.NOKLAIM as "viewnotelp", ( select PINWILKLAIM from POOLDATA.BRANCHKLAIMPNC where ID = (Select D.BRANCHCODE from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) ) as "HideKTP", ( select KANWILKLAIM from POOLDATA.BRANCHKLAIMPNC where ID = (Select D.BRANCHCODE from pooldata.t_claim_pnc D where d.claimid = c.pzinskey) ) as "HidePelapor", ( select alasantolak from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment where claimid = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-WORK ' || a.noklaim and objectid = k.objectid and alasantolak is not null fetch next 1 row only ) as "TypeOldNoHp" FROM datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work c LEFT JOIN datapega.pc_assign_worklist b ON c.pzInsKey = b.pxrefobjectkey LEFT JOIN pooldata.business f ON c.BUSINESSCODE_1 = f.id LEFT JOIN pooldata.businessgroup e ON f.businessgroupid = e.id LEFT JOIN pooldata.T_CLAIM_OBJECTLIST k ON k.claimid = c.pzinskey LEFT JOIN pooldata.pega_dashboardpnc a ON a.noklaim = c.pyid WHERE c.pxobjclass = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-Work-PNC' AND c.ISPENDINGCLOSE = 'true' {ASIS:TempBisnis.BUSINESSTYPE}
